newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Common position expected on public procurement.
newsitem.headline: Common position expected on public procurement.

text.p: The Internal Market Council is expected to strike a common position on Tuesday on a proposal to adapt the EU's public procurement directives to take account of the Government Procurement Agreement operated within the World Trade Organisation.

The common position could be adopted after the European Commission last week proposed amendments to the draft, which concerns the directives on the so-called "excluded sectors" of water, energy, transport and telecommunications.

The modifications were made to ensure that third country suppliers do not enjoy better access to contracts than Community suppliers and to introduce more flexibility into the technical dialogue between suppliers and procurement entities.
